C1153.title: Boundary Challenges and Ecosystem Governance: China's 2025 Internet Content Governance Report
C1153.summary: A report released in February 2026 highlights that six major platforms disclosed their algorithmic rules in 2025, aiding algorithmic governance transparency. It outlines ten typical cases, including the implementation of generative AI content labeling measures and platform algorithm rule disclosures.
